research_notes.name: Agrifield Operations Inbox
research_notes.finding: Myca is a direct global competitor: agribusiness field-team buyer, WhatsApp/photo intake, structured updates and follow-up coordination. Turkey has direct overlap: Çiftçi Takip offers visits, photos, tasks, offline and central reporting; AgroSaha offers dealer/engineer field workflow. Planports is adjacent broader CRM, Tarla.io adjacent satellite/agronomic data.
research_notes.next: Verify Myca and Turkish agriculture field-ops software competitors; local evidence.
